runs.question: What does the memo require agencies to do within 180 days?

answer.text:
The passages don't say which memo you mean, and three of them set 180-day deadlines.

**OMB M-25-21 (April 2025):** Within 180 days of issuance, or of any update, each agency must submit to OMB and post publicly either a plan for consistency with the memo or a written determination that it does not use, and does not expect to use, covered AI. Agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum. The same passage says the compliance plans must be updated every two years through 2036.

**OMB M-24-10 (March 2024):** The compliance-plan requirement is the same. Consistent with Section 104(c) and (d) of the AI in Government Act of 2020, within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to OMB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI. Agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum.

**OMB M-25-22 (April 2025):** The consolidated action table lists a 180-day deadline for agencies to achieve full compliance with the memo's guidance. Achieve full compliance with the guidance of this memorandum. The text of this table is garbled in the extraction, so I can't confirm the exact row layout. The table also sets a 200-day deadline for agencies to include the process by which the agency will standardize the treatment of data ownership and IP rights in procurements for AI systems or services, which is outside the 180-day window.

The passages do not say whether M-25-21 replaces M-24-10 on the compliance-plan requirement, so I can't say which governs. If you meant one specific memo, tell me which one and I can narrow the answer.

data.text:
Under OMB M-25-21, agencies must submit a compliance plan within 180 days. Consistent with Section 104(c) and (d) of the AI in Government Act of 2020, within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to OMB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI. Agencies also have to plan for revising their existing internal AI principles and guidelines so they match the memo.

Two points on the earlier answer:

- **Correction:** I earlier said the compliance plans must be "updated" every two years. The passage describes new submissions, not updates. Agencies submit the plan or determination every two years through 2036.
- **Other deadlines:** The 180-day compliance-plan requirement is the only 180-day obligation I can confirm in M-25-21. A separate 270-day deadline covers updating internal policies on IT infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, and privacy, so it is not part of the 180-day requirement. Within 270 days of the issuance of this memorandum, agencies must revisit and update where necessary their internal policies on IT infrastructure, and the same deadline covers data, cybersecurity, and privacy policies. The appendix timeline table for M-25-21 is garbled in the extracted text, so I can't verify from these passages whether it lists any other 180-day items.
